name: 脆甜多汁网纹蜜瓜鲜果款

styleLock.backgroundSystem: fresh grass green #5F9E38 panels and pale young-green #DCEFC8 sections for info shots, real tabletop scenes for lifestyle shots
styleLock.lightingSystem: soft warm top light with gentle front fill, soft contact shadows, fresh juicy mood, natural highlight roll-off, never plastic
styleLock.surfaceSystem: white-washed wood #EDE8E0, dark rustic wood #4A3A2C, woven bamboo trays and ceramic plates
styleLock.typography: modern bold geometric sans-serif headlines only, charcoal text #2F3A2A
styleLock.iconSystem: simple filled leaf-style icons and circular callout badges in #5F9E38, thin-line crossed-circle exclusion badges
styleLock.presentationRules: whole melon stable at a slight 3/4 hero angle, cut wedges and cubes used for detail and scene shots, consistent produce scale across the set
styleLock.lockText: Campaign Style Lock: consistent fresh juicy produce ecommerce visual system across the entire image set; fixed palette of fresh grass green #5F9E38, pale young-green #DCEFC8, clean white #FFFFFF, charcoal text #2F3A2A and one melon-flesh orange accent #F2A65E; warm natural lighting with soft top light, gentle front fill and soft contact shadows, fresh juicy mood, never plastic; modern bold geometric sans-serif headlines only; consistent rounded info cards, circular callout badges and thin-line exclusion badges in #5F9E38; clean high-end food photography mixed with minimal infographic elements; stable product scale, fresh produce always shown with natural surface texture and subtle water droplets; every frame composed as one complete balanced layout with natural breathing margins; no color palette changes, no mixed fonts, no random backgrounds, no inconsistent lighting, no mismatched icon styles, no plastic-looking fruit surfaces.

provenance.notes: 从 8 张绿色系网纹蜜瓜爆款详情长图切片提炼；已剥离源品牌字样、二维码、原文案与会员入口；源图的新疆产地声明与规格数据（净含量/保质期）无独立证据，一律不带入图中，文案槽统一改为 {callout} 由使用方按可核实信息填写；品类按 taxonomy 判定为生鲜粮油/水果，leaf 采用通用名网纹蜜瓜鲜果，不携带地理标志产地承诺；售后切片中残留的他品类文案已忽略。
